actions.body:
Hello Nessa,

Thanks for confirming the pallet for DL-043 is ready. Plover Arc Logistics' freight booking desk can't allocate a collection vehicle yet because the pallet's dimensions and weight are blank on the booking. Please reply here with values measured from the actual pallet (not estimates):

1. Length (cm)
2. Width (cm)
3. Height (cm), measured from the floor to the highest point, including the pallet base
4. Gross weight (kg), meaning the full loaded weight including the pallet

If the load can't be stacked or needs special handling, please say so too.

When you send these, I'll pass them straight to the freight booking desk so they can allocate a vehicle. Please note that this is a request for information, not a booking confirmation. I can't confirm a collection date or vehicle until Plover Arc gives one.

Kind regards,
Iona Quill
Rivet Delivery Desk
